1.name: SW
1.hint: drain of the NDMOS switch: to the inductor and the freewheeling Schottky diode's anode (its cathode to VIN); open LEDs stop the oscillation and SW falls to GND (p. 2, 13)

3.name: CTRL
3.hint: on/off and brightness: floating for normal operation; below 0.2 V off (shutdown 50 / 80 µA); DC 0.3 … 2.5 V adjusts 0 … 100 % of IOUT_NOM linearly, above 2.5 V clamped to 100 %; PWM from an open-collector or open-drain transistor or a 3.3 V logic output, below 500 Hz for 1 % … 100 %; a capacitor to GND adds about 1.5 ms/nF soft start (p. 2, 4, 11, 12)

4.name: SET
4.hint: RS from this pin to VIN sets the nominal average output current IOUT_NOM = 0.1 V / RS (p. 2, 11)

5.name: VIN
5.hint: input 4.5 … 40 V; decouple to ground with 10 µF or more X7R ceramic close to the device (p. 2, 12)

needs.source: Diodes Incorporated AL8860 data sheet DS39014 Rev. 8 - 2 (April 2026), p. 2 pin descriptions: 'Decouple to ground with 10μF or higher X7R ceramic capacitor close to device'

hints: nominal average output current IOUT_NOM = 0.1 V / RS (0.1 Ω → 1 A, 0.13 Ω → 760 mA, 0.3 Ω → 333 mA); VSENSE 96 / 100 / 104 mV; TSOT25 up to 1 A continuous, the MSOP-8EP (AL8860MP-13) up to 1.5 A (p. 3, 4, 11)
the input must stay above the LED string: on time L × ΔI / (VIN − VLED − ILED × (RS + RL + RSW)), RSW 0.3 Ω nominal; maximum duty cycle 98 % typ, recommended 25 … 75 % (p. 4, 13)
inductor 33 … 100 µH, more at higher supply voltage; saturation current above the peak output current, continuous rating above the mean current; ripple ΔI internally 0.40 × ILED (p. 13)
freewheeling diode: a fast low-capacitance Schottky with a peak rating above the peak coil current and a continuous rating above the load current (p. 12)
overtemperature protection at 150 °C with 30 °C hysteresis; an LED chain shorted together keeps the regulated switch current (p. 4, 13)
